{"settings":"{
  // Телеметрия нахуй
  "telemetry.telemetryLevel": "off",
  "telemetry.enableCrashReporter": false,
  "telemetry.enableTelemetry": false,
  "telemetry.consented": false,

  // Внешний вид
  "window.titleBarStyle": "custom",
  "editor.fontFamily": "'JetBrains Mono'",
  "editor.lineHeight": 1.5,
  "editor.fontLigatures": true,
  "editor.cursorBlinking": "smooth",
  "editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation": "on",
  "editor.renderWhitespace": "selection",
  "editor.smoothScrolling": true,
  "editor.minimap.maxColumn": 100,
  "editor.guides.bracketPairs": true,
  "workbench.layoutControl.type": "menu",
  "editor.scrollbar.vertical": "hidden",
  "editor.overviewRulerBorder": false,
  "editor.scrollbar.horizontal": "hidden",
  "editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize": 0,
  "editor.folding": false,
  "editor.hideCursorInOverviewRuler": true,

  // Производительность
  "editor.maxTokenizationLineLength": 20000,
  "files.watcherExclude": {
    "**/.git/objects/**": true,
    "**/.git/subtree-cache/**": true,
    "**/node_modules/**": true,
    "**/result/**": true,
    "**/result-*/**": true
  },

  // Поведение редактора
  "editor.formatOnSave": true,
  "editor.formatOnPaste": true,
  "editor.mouseWheelZoom": true,
  "editor.tabSize": 2,
  "editor.insertSpaces": true,
  "editor.detectIndentation": true,
  "editor.wordWrap": "on",
  "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true,
  "files.insertFinalNewline": true,
  "files.trimFinalNewlines": true,

  // Терминал
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux": "fish",
  "terminal.integrated.fontFamily": "JetBrains Mono",
  "terminal.integrated.cursorBlinking": true,
  "terminal.integrated.cursorStyle": "line",

  // Git
  "git.enableSmartCommit": true,
  "git.confirmSync": false,
  "git.autofetch": true,

  // Wayland специфичное
  "window.enableMenuBarMnemonics": false,
  "window.customMenuBarAltFocus": false,

  // Дополнительные фишки
  "editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true,
  "editor.stickyScroll.enabled": false,
  "editor.inlineSuggest.enabled": true,
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "explorer.confirmDragAndDrop": false,
  "workbench.startupEditor": "none",
  "workbench.tree.indent": 10,
  "breadcrumbs.enabled": true,

  // NixOS специфичное
  "nix.enableLanguageServer": true,
  "nix.serverPath": "nil",
  "nix.serverSettings": {
    "nil": {
      "formatting": {
        "command": ["nixpkgs-fmt"]
      }
    }
  },
  "vs-kubernetes": {
    "vscode-kubernetes.helm-path-linux": "/home/jondaw/.local/state/vs-kubernetes/tools/helm/linux-amd64/helm",
    "vscode-kubernetes.kubectl-path-linux": "/home/jondaw/.local/state/vs-kubernetes/tools/kubectl/kubectl",
    "vscode-kubernetes.minikube-path-linux": "/home/jondaw/.local/state/vs-kubernetes/tools/minikube/linux-amd64/minikube"
  },
  "workbench.colorTheme": "Catppuccin Mocha",
  "workbench.iconTheme": "catppuccin-mocha",
  "editor.fontSize": 16,
  "files.autoSave": "afterDelay",
  "git.ignoreRebaseWarning": true,
  "window.customTitleBarVisibility": "auto",
  "files.associations": {
    "config": "jsonc"
  },
  "supermaven.enableFixWithSupermaven": false,
  "aws.telemetry": false,
  "editor.minimap.showSlider": "always",
  "editor.minimap.renderCharacters": false,
  "editor.minimap.size": "fill",
  "[yaml]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "yaml.extension.recommendations": true,
  "[html]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "[css]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "workbench.productIconTheme": "icons-octicons",
  "[jsonc]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
  },
  "update.showReleaseNotes": false,
  "extensions.autoUpdate": "onlyEnabledExtensions",
  "update.mode": "none"
}"}
